{{# PersonName fieldtype (App\Fieldtypes\PersonName) — structured name with text + phonetic-text pair subfields, no_* skip toggles, optional nickname, generational suffix select, and an optional preferred display-format select. `PersonName::extraRenderableFieldData()` surfaces `generational_suffix_options` and `display_format_options`. The per-pair markup (text + phonetic-text side by side) lives in `_person_name_pair.antlers.html`; this template calls it once per name part, wrapping in an Alpine show/hide block when the part has a `no_*` skip toggle. Conditional hide via no_* toggles uses Alpine's reactive form scope. The form's x-data, emitted by Statamic\Forms\JsDrivers\Alpine, already initializes `.no_middle_name` / `.no_nickname` / `.no_generational_suffix` to false (per PersonName::emptyValue()). Each checkbox binds `:checked` to that scope variable and writes its new state back through `@change` (boolean, not the value attr). Dependent inputs use `x-show` to hide. Server submission stays standard HTML: `name="[no_middle_name]" value="1"` posts "1" when checked, omits the key when unchecked, and PersonName::normalizeStored casts whatever it sees to bool. Avoid `$root..` here — `$root` is the DOM element, not the scope, so dot access against it always reads as undefined and the toggle silently no-ops in Alpine. Required-attr semantics match PersonName::extraRules() — see the partial. #}} {{ parent_required = ( validate | contains:required ) }} {{# Antlers `??` is Elvis-style (falsy-coalescing) so `include_X ?? true` would always fall through when the blueprint sets `include_X: false`. Antlers `???` is the strict null-coalescing variant — only triggers on null, keeps a literal `false`. Use it for every include_*-with-default check below. #}}
